[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Domino and tromino tiling** [LC 790 · Domino and Tromino Tiling](https://leetcode.com/problems/domino-and-tromino-tiling/){difficulty="Medium"}

Fill the board column by column. A tromino leaves the next column **half** filled, so "the first $i$ columns are full" is not enough as a state. Add a second state: the first $i$ columns are full **and one cell of column $i+1$ sticks out**. Two coupled recurrences then collapse into one.

[Solved in full in @sec-dpi-p1-tiling.]{.card-link}

:::
